name: Gonzaga University
description: Gonzaga University a private university located in Spokane, Washington. Ranked #80 in U.S. News & World Report's Best National Universities, Gonzaga gives international students a prestigious degree with access to companies like Amazon, Boeing, and Microsoft.Gonzaga offers students a private liberal arts education in 49 majors with more than nearly 60 minors and 50 different concentrations. Top majors include Business Administration, Marketing, Social Sciences, Management, Engineering, and Biological and Biomedical Sciences. In each program students experience considerable one-on-one attention from professors with Gonzaga's 11:1 student-to-faculty ratio and small class sizes averaging 24 students. Timestamps Updated
